subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: While materialized items are in flight, the drive shall drive each resulting proposal to a content-verified landing through the lane's routing, and shall close the feature only on mainline-content verification of every proposal.
rationale: the fleet bridge ends at the goal object, never a badge
fit_criterion: e2e drill: closure occurs only after every proposal's content is verified an ancestor of the mainline; a stranded proposal blocks closure and alarms
